units.summary: Adds an idempotent setter that appends the from-selected-series hint and sorts the hints. The hint is written to meta.json on disk.
units.headline: New setter adds from-selected-series compaction hint idempotently
units.reason: It adds a new persisted hint value to the block meta.json format.
focus: Check that older readers and Thanos/Mimir tolerate the unknown hint string in meta.json

units.summary: Predicate that reports whether the hint is present. It drives exclusion from inOrderBlocksMaxTime and hint propagation.
units.headline: Predicate reports the from-selected-series hint
units.reason: Simple slices.Contains check; its callers carry the risk.

units.summary: New unit test for the setter and predicate, covering idempotency and co-existence with the stale hint. Test-only, so it cannot change production behavior.
units.headline: Test covers selected-series hint round-trip and idempotency
units.reason: New test only.

units.summary: Write now carries the selected-series hint from the base meta into the new block's meta, mirroring the stale-series hint.
units.headline: Compactor Write carries selected-series hint over from base meta
units.reason: It changes what metadata compacted blocks persist.
focus: Whether the hint should survive when blocks are merged with normal blocks via Compact

units.summary: Blocks with the selected-series hint no longer count toward the in-order max time. This affects OOO compaction and head-truncation decisions.
units.headline: Selected-series blocks excluded from in-order max-time computation
units.reason: It changes the watermark logic used by compaction.
focus: Callers of inOrderBlocksMaxTime (OOO compaction, retention) behave correctly when these blocks are ignored

units.summary: New test showing that series with OOO data are skipped and the rest are compacted. Test-only.
units.headline: Test verifies OOO series are skipped by CompactSelectedSeries
units.reason: New test only.

units.reason: New test only.

units.summary: New test checking that inOrderBlocksMaxTime ignores selected-series blocks. Test-only.
units.headline: Test verifies inOrderBlocksMaxTime ignores selected-series blocks
